blocks.description: A line with five events: enter, decision, write, exit and end. An arc between two events marks a step. Below, a state change: n = 3.

caption.text: Every trace event is a step. The memory state at any event is rebuilt by adding up the changes from the start.

runs.text: : written variables, created objects, frames pushed or popped. Adding up the changes from the start gives the full state at any event, and asking about a past event again always gives the same answer. Events are delivered in batches of whatever size the host prefers, without losses or duplicates.

points.text: The trace is the list of events; a step is an event.
Next, step into and step out are defined on events.
State changes rebuild memory at any point.
